items.title: CXMT, Sandisk, ASML, SpaceX, D-Wave Quantum, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  Chip stocks were selling off and weighing on major indexes following reports that a state-backed Chinese company has begun mass producing chip-making machines.  Those same semiconductor companies, and many artificial-intelligence names, also were under pressure Monday after Chinese memory chip maker ChangXin Memory Technologies ’(CXMT) massive trading debut.

items.title: Chip stocks slide as China advances domestic lithography, memory production
items.summary: Shares of major chipmakers fell sharply on Monday after reports that a state-backed Chinese firm has begun mass-producing domestic deep ultraviolet (DUV) lithography machines. ASML Holding NV (NASDAQ:ASML, XETRA:ASME) dropped more than 7% as China's progress in domestic DUV production...

items.title: ARM to Post Q1 Earnings: Should the Stock Be in Your Portfolio Now?
items.summary: ARM Holdings reports fiscal Q1 earnings soon, with expectations for double-digit growth, but a soaring share price and premium valuation may leave little room for disappointment.

items.title: AI Stocks Crash After NVIDIA Plans to Finance $250 Billion OpenAI Buildout Are Reported
items.summary: A Wall Street Journal report about NVIDIA potentially backstopping OpenAI's compute ambitions at a staggering scale has triggered a broad selloff across AI hardware names, and the concern investors cannot shake goes straight to the heart of how sustainable the AI spending boom really is.

items.title: Sandisk, ASML, and More Chip Stocks Hit China Roadblocks
items.summary: FEATURE  China threw up a couple of roadblocks for chips stocks Monday, forcing Sandisk ASML Holding and a host of others into the ditch. The obstacles: a massive Chinese IPO and a state-backed company’s mass production of chip-making machines.
